description: When a user starts, completes, or has an error during the change or reset master password flow. The start of the flow corresponds to the first page prompting a user to change the master password. If the flow_step is "error", include the error property. When resetting the master password, there will also be a "forget_master_password" event preceding the start of the change_master_password flow. The flow is "cancelled" when the user exits out of the entire change flow (not simply when they go back to a previous change master password page). On Web, only at successful change, we send whether the MP was leaked prior to its change.
